name: Ibiden Co., Ltd.
blurb: Ibiden Co., Ltd. (TSE: 4862) is a Japanese manufacturer headquartered in Ogaki, Gifu Prefecture, whose semiconductor packaging division produces ABF (Ajinomoto Build-up Film) IC substrates — the multi-layer organic structures that connect high-end processor dies to circuit boards. Ibiden is one of only five companies in the world with the process capability to manufacture these substrates at scale, making it a structural chokepoint for AI GPU supply. The company also produces industrial ceramics and electronic components, but its substrate business drives valuation.
recent: Ibiden opened its new Ono Plant in October 2025, its largest domestic production facility, designed specifically for AI server IC substrate production. The facility began at 25% capacity, with a ramp to 50% targeted by March 2026. Ibiden had previously announced plans for a 40% output increase in AI-server substrates over 2025. The company's substrate revenue is closely correlated with Nvidia GPU shipment volumes, as Ibiden is among Nvidia's primary ABF substrate suppliers.
